paras: The Mussau triller (Lalage conjuncta) is a smaller member of the cuckooshrike family, Campephagidae.  It was formerly considered a subspecies of the varied triller. It is found on the St Matthias Islands in the Bismarck Archipelago. Photographed and sound-recorded for the first time in 2024, the species is now thought to be restricted to the centre of the island and may be at risk due to logging.
